thread:
emma: heads-up: we're doing a whitespace open-mic in the lounge at 4pm. bring your quirkiest indents and semver puns.
ryan: i'll bring a kazoo and a semver joke. ready: 'why did the patch go to therapy? it couldn't handle its minor issues' :laughing:
priya: that's both tragic and accurate. also, freeform config karaoke?
emma: yes. first act: a YAML striptease (only remove trailing spaces)
ryan: second act: 'Linker Heartbreak' - a spoken word about unresolved externals
priya: quick config submission i found in the wild:
```yaml
service:
  id: chorus-1
  version: '1.2'  # dev optimism vs. semver reality
  owner: "team-whitespace"
```
emma: 1.2 is the indie EP of versions. needs a patch to hit the charts.
ops-bot: lint-warning: manifest.version "1.2" is not strict semver. recommended: "1.2.0". Deploy checks may fail. :warning:
ryan: ops-bot dropping truth bombs as always.
priya: low-effort poll: what's the best semver persona? Major (dramatic), Minor (mysterious), Patch (reliable)
emma: Patch is the unsung hero :sparkles:
ryan: Minor is mysterious and flirty :smirk:
priya: Major writes memoirs about breaking changes :open_book:
ops-bot: Reminder: upcoming release pipeline will enforce full semver on manifests. Please update versions by EOD to avoid automatic rollback.
emma: i'll hand out "I survived the semver roast" stickers after the open-mic.
ryan: i'm composing a kazoo solo called "Off-by-One Blues". anyone want to duet?
priya: i'll provide percussion (tap etiquette: no tabs unless agreed upon)
emma: rules: no commas in YAML, no semicolons, and if your config has feelings, name them. see you at 4pm ;)
